Sift — one SRE product for logs, metrics, and traces

Usage: sift <COMMAND>

Commands:
  serve       Run the unified h2c/HTTP1 operational-event service
  collect     Collect axiom.service.log.v1 JSONL from a file, stdin, or Kubernetes CRI logs
  query       Run one versioned logs, metrics, or traces query through the Sift API
  mcp         Serve the read-only Sift MCP tools
  snapshot    Write a consistent Sift journal snapshot to stdout or a local file
  restore     Restore a journal snapshot from a shared backup object URI
  backup      Ship a live or explicitly offline journal snapshot through the shared backup contract
  dockerfile  Render source or release image Dockerfiles independently of Kubernetes
  k8s         Render cluster CRD, operator control plane, or namespaced Sift instances
  connect     Run a command through a managed Kubernetes port-forward to Sift
  spec        Print Sift's API contract or generate a typed client from it
  llm         Print offline agent-facing operational documentation
  upgrade     Check or install a released Sift binary
  issue       Search, inspect, or file Sift issues
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

backup:
Ship a live or explicitly offline journal snapshot through the shared backup contract

Usage: sift backup [OPTIONS] --dest <DEST>

Options:
      --url <URL>
          Running Sift base URL. Fetches the protected /admin/backup snapshot [env: SIFT_BACKUP_URL=]
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Legacy offline mode: open this stopped journal directly
      --token <TOKEN>
          Admin bearer token for live mode. Invalid with offline --data-dir [env: SIFT_BACKUP_TOKEN=]
      --token-file <TOKEN_FILE>
          Rotating projected ServiceAccount token for live mode [env: SIFT_TOKEN_FILE=]
      --token-audience <TOKEN_AUDIENCE>
          [env: SIFT_TOKEN_AUDIENCE=] [default: sift.axiom.dev]
      --project <PROJECT>
          Project checked by Kubernetes SubjectAccessReview for live backup [env: SIFT_PROJECT=] [default: *]
      --dest <DEST>
          Shared backup destination URI: file://, s3://, or gs://
      --retention-secs <RETENTION_SECS>
          Remove backup objects older than this many seconds after a successful write
  -h, --help
          Print help
collect:
Collect axiom.service.log.v1 JSONL from a file, stdin, or Kubernetes CRI logs

Usage: sift collect [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --source <SOURCE>
          JSONL source path, or `-` for stdin
      --cri-root <CRI_ROOT>
          Kubernetes node CRI pod-log root, normally /var/log/pods
      --source-id <SOURCE_ID>
          Stable identity used with byte offsets to derive idempotency keys
      --endpoint <ENDPOINT>
          Sift service base URL [env: SIFT_URL=] [default: http://127.0.0.1:7380]
      --token <TOKEN>
          Optional Sift bearer token [env: SIFT_TOKEN=]
      --token-file <TOKEN_FILE>
          Rotating projected ServiceAccount token. The file is read for every request [env: SIFT_TOKEN_FILE=]
      --token-audience <TOKEN_AUDIENCE>
          Required audience in a projected ServiceAccount token [env: SIFT_TOKEN_AUDIENCE=] [default: sift.axiom.dev]
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Persistent Sift root used for agent checkpoints and rejected records [env: SIFT_DATA_DIR=] [default: /var/lib/sift]
      --project <PROJECT>
          [default: default]
      --environment <ENVIRONMENT>
          [default: local]
      --gcp-project <GCP_PROJECT>
          GCP project used for k8s_container monitored-resource identity [env: GCP_PROJECT_ID=]
      --cluster <CLUSTER>
          [env: GKE_CLUSTER_NAME=]
      --location <LOCATION>
          [env: GKE_LOCATION=]
      --node <NODE>
          [env: NODE_NAME=]
      --checkpoint <CHECKPOINT>
          Durable source offset checkpoint; defaults under DATA_DIR/agent
      --quarantine <QUARANTINE>
          Invalid-line JSONL sink; defaults beside the checkpoint
      --batch-size <BATCH_SIZE>
          [default: 100]
      --max-line-bytes <MAX_LINE_BYTES>
          [default: 524288]
      --max-retries <MAX_RETRIES>
          [default: 3]
      --request-timeout-secs <REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECS>
          [default: 10]
      --follow
          Continue watching a regular file or refreshing CRI discovery after EOF
      --follow-poll-ms <FOLLOW_POLL_MS>
          [default: 250]
  -h, --help
          Print help
connect:
Run a command through a managed Kubernetes port-forward to Sift

Usage: sift connect [OPTIONS] --namespace <NAMESPACE> -- <COMMAND>...

Arguments:
  <COMMAND>...  Command to run with `SIFT_URL` and, when available, `SIFT_TOKEN` set

Options:
      --context <CONTEXT>          kubectl context to port-forward through; omit to use the current context
      --namespace <NAMESPACE>      Namespace of the target Service or Sift custom resource
      --service <SERVICE>          Target Service name; defaults to `--cr` when a custom resource is named
      --cr <CR>                    Sift custom-resource name used to discover the target Service and token Secret
      --local-port <LOCAL_PORT>    Local port to forward to; omit to allocate an ephemeral port
      --remote-port <REMOTE_PORT>  Remote Service port [default: 7380]
      --secret <SECRET>            Token-registry Secret name. Auto-discovered from `--cr` when omitted
      --token <TOKEN>              Explicit bearer token; otherwise one is selected from the token registry [env: SIFT_TOKEN=]
      --role <ROLE>                Minimum role required of a token selected from the registry [default: admin] [possible values: read, write, admin]
      --resource <RESOURCE>        Optional resource scope used while selecting a registry token
  -h, --help                       Print help
